Title: [LSJ] Free Fight and Games of Instinct

Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
A Hermana Menor plays Games of Instinct to enter combat with a 3-cap
vampire. The action is successful. The Hermana then plays Free Fight,
and Angelo tags in as the new combatant. He trashes the 3-cap without
himself going to torpor. Does Angelo fill to capacity with blood as a
result?

I'm pretty sure he does, but wanted to make sure.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He gets blood, but not necessarily enough to fill him to capacity.
He only gains 3 blood -- 3 being the capacity of the opposing vampire.

--
That is my story, be it bitter or be it sweet.
Keep a little and let a little come back to me.
